name: Carter
craft: a covered cart drawn by a horse-lizard
who: Carters of the western plain and the northern valleys, Imperial-descended, Lukiul or Dunmer
why: Gideon keeps Cyrodiilic habits and the Blackwood Road; Stormhold has Dunmer stone roads; lizard-steeds replace horses that bog down (story/lore/extrapolation/argonia-4e201-state.md; story/lore/topics/fauna-hazards.md).

name: Raft-master
craft: a poled raft or a paddled canoe
who: Argonian raft-men and canoe-men of the inland water and the sheltered coast
why: Personal rafts are the default vehicle; the Agaceph pole a one-person raft with the tail; outsiders travel behind a hired Argonian guide who chooses where to go and when (The Argonian Account, Bk 4; Lore:Lost Tales of the Famed Explorer; story/lore/topics/material-culture.md).

name: Root-tender
craft: a rootworm called to the root pool
who: A tree-minder or rootworm handler of the Hist
why: Argonians ride the rootworms routinely; only the Hist's own people know its roots (story/lore/regions/middle-argonia.md).

name: Harbour boatman
craft: a small-draft coaster or lighter with a sail
who: Argonian and Dunmer sailors in the ports, on boats of Dunmer and Imperial build
why: Argonians rarely build big ships but crew other races' ships, commonly Dunmer or Imperial; Archon, Lilmoth and Soulrest are the major seaports, Alten Corimont, Stormhold and Thorn the minor (Lore:Sea Transportation; story/lore/topics/material-culture.md).
